name: premium-product-video-maker
description: Direct premium, Apple-style product videos and deliver the production package — Brand Lock, concept and arc, frame-by-frame storyboard, type and color tokens, music brief, SFX list, After Effects or AI video prompt pack, and QA. Use for product launch films, feature videos, app/UI hero shots, and paid-social product cuts for SaaS, fintech, crypto, wallets, payments, and hardware. Use it whenever the user asks for a product video, launch or teaser film, or its storyboard, shot list, motion brief, After Effects plan, or AI video prompts (Sora, Veo, Runway, Kling), especially when it should feel premium, expensive, clean, minimal, or Apple-like, or when an existing product video looks cheap and needs fixing. Not for talking-head explainers, tutorials, meme or hype edits, rap-and-whoosh packs, or feature dumps.
